principle: The fixed shell owns presentation and interaction. The paper manifest must contain reader-ready scientific content, with sentence-level bilingual alignment, source-positioned citations and figure/table links, complete terminology, and visually audited figure studies.

modules.reader_question: What paper am I reading and why is it relevant?
requirements: title_zh is a fluent scientific Chinese translation rather than copied English
authors and affiliations are extracted as actual names and institutions
publication_timeline includes available received, revised, accepted, online and issue dates
citation contains volume, issue or article number, page range and PDF pages when available
journal_scope explains the journal in one factual sentence
field_positioning explains the paper's disciplinary position in one reader-facing sentence
forbidden: Authors listed in the source PDF

modules.reader_question: Can I understand the entire study before reading the body?
fixed_questions: 模型或分析的输入与输出是什么？
主要生物学发现是什么？
requirements: each answer is a specific synthesis of this paper, normally 35-140 Chinese characters
core data names cohorts, sample sizes, modalities and paired or validation relationships
input-output states the analytical object, transformation and final output, not a copied Methods paragraph
biological finding and clinical result are distinct and include concrete findings
limitations state limitations reported or directly supported by the study design
method is a concise arrow-linked workflow of 5-9 stages
story is a one-paragraph conclusion explaining what the study establishes and what it does not

modules.reader_question: Does the body follow the scientific argument rather than the PDF layout?
requirements: retain genuine article section and subsection boundaries in source order
every English heading has an accurate Chinese heading
front-page title fragments, highlights bullets, author lines, running headers and figure labels are not sections
duplicate References headings are collapsed to one reference area
methods subsections remain available but do not replace the paper's results narrative

modules.reader_question: Can I read and interact with the original and translation sentence by sentence without losing paragraph context?
requirements: source paragraphs are reconstructed before translation, including cross-column and cross-page continuation recovery
each reconstructed paragraph is segmented into complete English sentences only after abbreviations, decimals, numeric ranges, equations, citations and figure references are protected
every English sentence has exactly one Chinese counterpart with a stable sentence-group identifier
clicking an English or Chinese sentence highlights only its one-to-one counterpart rather than the entire paragraph
English is source-faithful and Chinese is a complete contextual translation with terminology kept consistent across the paper
rejoining all English sentence pieces reconstructs the recovered source paragraph without omission or duplication
rejoining all Chinese sentence pieces reconstructs the complete translated paragraph without omission or duplication
terms are highlighted only after sentence pairing and translation are stable

modules.reader_question: Do citations and figure/table references remain exactly where the paper uses them?
requirements: reference citations remain attached to the source sentence and original semantic position
citation ranges map to all included reference IDs without converting scientific numbers into citations
scientific numbers such as years, grades, cohort sizes, percentages, statistics and figure panel numbers are validated separately from citation IDs
figure and table references remain inline at the original textual location and are directly clickable there
clicking an inline figure or table reference opens or focuses the corresponding reader asset
inline references are not moved to paragraph ends and are not regenerated as a detached list
forbidden: all citations appended at paragraph end
all figure links appended at paragraph end
scientific number interpreted as bibliography ID

modules.reader_question: Can I tell what a figure proves before opening it, and can I understand every major subpanel after opening it?
requirements: title includes the figure number and complete descriptive title
intro is a 1-2 sentence reader-facing description of the figure's role in the paper
image contains the complete source figure at readable resolution
caption_en is the complete source legend without body-paragraph contamination
caption_zh is a full Chinese translation
study.overview explains how to read the whole figure and its relation to adjacent figures
a visual inventory is performed on the rendered source figure before panel explanations are written
study.panels contains every labeled panel and every meaningful unlabeled logical block needed to understand a composite figure
panel explanations identify the plotted object, comparison, axes or visual encoding when applicable, the actual result shown and the panel's role in the argument
panel labels in the reader match the visual inventory and source caption; missing or invented panels fail release
large composite figures receive proportionally detailed panel explanations rather than caption paraphrases
study.conclusion states the figure-level conclusion and the next logical step
forbidden: raw internal figure ID visible to readers

modules.reader_question: Can I inspect a table as structured data rather than as an unreadable screenshot?
requirements: source tables are emitted with kind=table
headers and rows preserve the source structure
title and caption are bilingual
inline table mentions open or focus this table from the body
an image fallback is allowed only when merged cells cannot be reconstructed, and must be explicitly audited

modules.reader_question: Can an unfamiliar reader understand the paper's recurring terminology in place?
requirements: include recurring domain, method and statistical terms that materially affect interpretation
definitions explain the term in the context of this paper
aliases cover source spelling and common abbreviations
term entries are actually instantiated as interactive highlights in the rendered body
a nontrivial scientific paper with effectively zero term highlights fails release unless explicitly justified and independently audited
do not highlight ordinary words or entire acronym expansions when only the canonical term should be interactive

modules.reader_question: Can I trace every citation to the correct source without losing its sentence context?
requirements: preserve original reference numbering
retain complete bibliographic text
citation ranges map to all included references
reference count and missing numbers are audited against the source
every rendered citation remains inline in the sentence where the source placed it and opens the appropriate reference card or group

release_rule: A raw PDF extraction may be stored for evidence, but it must not be rendered as a candidate reader until all reader-facing modules pass the content-quality validator and the rendered result is not functionally weaker than config/v082_latest_reader_standard.json.
